description: Land Acquisition - Thoddaveli, Mannar Town D/S Division, Mannar District - Periyakarisal, Mannar Town D/S Division, Mannar District - Kaddukarakudiyiruppu, Mannar Town D/S Division, Mannar District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and locations, along with orders for taking possession of these lands. While it mentions a government minister (Harin Fernando), the core content is about land acquisition procedures and property descriptions, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
